audience: teams that check addresses and contact details in the UK, Ireland, the Netherlands and Singapore

useCases.title: Find an address from a partial entry
useCases.text: Get ranked address suggestions for a partial address, then resolve the chosen suggestion to its full address.

useCases.title: List the addresses at a postcode
useCases.text: List the addresses at a postcode, one page at a time.

useCases.title: Refresh a stored address by UDPRN
useCases.text: Read the address for a Royal Mail UDPRN. A not-found reply means the address is not on the dataset.

useCases.title: Check an email address
useCases.text: Check whether an email address has a domain that resolves and has mail records.

useCases.title: Check a phone number and the key status
useCases.text: Read the country and formats of a phone number with its country code. Check that the API key is available.
